pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ aññataraṃ kulaṃ ubhato pasannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.3: saddhāya vaḍḍhati bhogena hāyati. yaṃ tasmiṃ kule uppajjati purebhattaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā taṃ sabbaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vissajjetvā appekadā anasitā acchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā na mattaṃ jānitvā paṭiggahessanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.6: ime imesaṃ datvā appekadā anasitā acchantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.8: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.9: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.10: “anujānāmi bhikkhave yaṃ kulaṃ saddhāya vaḍḍhati bhogena hāyati, evarūpassa kulassa ñattidutiyena kammena sekhasammutiṃ dātuṃ”
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.14: itthannāmaṃ kulaṃ saddhāya vaḍḍhati bhogena hāyati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.15: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmassa kulassa sekhasammutiṃ dadeyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.18: itthannāmaṃ kulaṃ saddhāya vaḍḍhati bhogena hāyati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.20: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa kulassa sekhasammutiyā dānaṃ, so tuṇhassa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.23: khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.24: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.25.1: yāni kho pana tāni sekhasammatāni kulāni yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpesu sekhasammatesu kulesu khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.26: gārayhaṃ āvuso dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ taṃ paṭidesemī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.27: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ ussavo hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.5: paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā sekhasammatesu kulesu khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādituṃ bhuñjitu”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.7: “kinnukho nāma amhākaṃ jīvitena yaṃ ayyā amhākaṃ na patigaṇhantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.10: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.11: “anujānāmi bhikkhave nimantitena sekhasammatesu kulesu khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādituṃ bhuñjituṃ”
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.12: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.13.1: “yāni kho pana tāni sekhasammatāni kulāni. yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpesu sekhasammatesu kulesu pubbe animantito khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.14: gārayhaṃ āvuso dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ taṃ paṭidesemī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.15: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu tassa kulassa kulūpago hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.2: atha kho so bhikkhu pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena taṃ kulaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.3: tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.4: atha kho te manussā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.7: bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ animantitena sekkhasammatesu kulesu khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādituṃ bhuñjitu”nti kukkuccāyanto na paṭiggahesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.10: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.12: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.13: “anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā sekhasammatesu kulesu khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādituṃ bhuñjituṃ.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.14: evañca pana, bhikkhave, imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.15.1: “yāni kho pana tāni sekhasammatāni kulāni, yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpesu sekhasammatesu kulesu pubbe animantito agilāno khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.16: gārayhaṃ āvuso dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ taṃ paṭidesemī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.1: yāni kho pana tāni sekhasammatāni kulānīti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.2: sekkhasammataṃ nāma kulaṃ yaṃ kulaṃ saddhāya vaḍḍhati bhogena hāyati evarūpassa kulassa ñattidutiyena kammena sekhasammuti dinnā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.10: ajjatanāya vā svātanāya vā animantito gharūpacāraṃ okkante nimanteti eso animantito nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.12: ajjatanāya vā svātanāya vā nimantito gharūpacāraṃ anokkamante nimanteti, eso nimantito nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.18: pañca bhojanāni yāmakālikaṃ sattāhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ khādanīyaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.20: pañca bhojanāni odano kummāso sattu maccho maṃsaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.21: animantito agilāno khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādissāmi bhuñjissāmīti patigaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa .
